games.title: Swords and Sandals
games.primary_version: Swords and Sandals 2: Emperor's Reign (2007 Flash, AS2)
games.legal_notes: Commercial rights tied to eGames.com LLC + Whiskeybarrel; AG was host only. Active Redux/Steam line.

games.title: The McDonald's Videogame (Molleindustria)
games.primary_version: Burger Tycoon (portal-safe twin of 2005/6 Flash 7 original)
games.legal_notes: Molleindustria CC claim (exact deed unverified). Branded McDonald's marks = trademark risk; prefer Burger Tycoon.

games.title: The Impossible Game
games.primary_version: Impossible Game Lite (Newgrounds Flash 2010) for SWF-exact; full game is XBLIG 2009 / non-Flash
games.legal_notes: Fluke Games owns; sequel active. Lite emulate OK technically; full recreate needs license (then approach shifts to RECREATE).

games.title: Boxhead: 2Play Rooms
games.primary_version: Boxhead: 2Play Rooms (2007 Flash; local co-op/deathmatch — not networked LAN)
games.legal_notes: Sean Cooper creator; Crazy Monkey historical sponsor; Fire Source/Immortal suggests ongoing commercial interest — clear before monetize.

games.title: Chicken Invaders
games.primary_version: Chicken Invaders 2: The Next Wave (2002 desktop) — official series is not Flash
games.legal_notes: InterAction studios actively sells remasters/Universe. Kongregate Flash 'Chicken Invaders' by hopslop is unofficial.

rationale_bullets: Armor Games catalog title with proven Ruffle listings — aligns with 'Make Armor Games Great Again' identity better than McDonald's or Chicken Invaders.
EMULATE path is fastest under no-plugin / exact-original constraint; wave-shooter scope is smaller than S&S RPG systems.
Local two-player shared-keyboard co-op is the strongest 30-second swarm demo among the five (clarified: not networked LAN).
Legal risk is medium (indie creator chain) vs high for S&S (eGames), Impossible full (Fluke), Chicken (InterAction), or branded McDonald's marks.
Nostalgia punch is high for AG Flash audiences; fidelity risk stays low if SWF+Ruffle is the ship vehicle.

approach_legend.EMULATE: Ruffle or SWF wrapper; prefer when official SWF exists and AVM1/compatible
approach_legend.RECREATE: Rebuild in modern engine; required when no authentic SWF or for full non-Flash titles
